title: Agencies may not open letters to ombudsman.
bodyText: A letter to the ombudsman from a person held in custody by an agency shall be forwarded immediately, unopened, to the ombudsman.
bodyHtml: §96-18  Agencies may not open letters to ombudsman.  A letter to the ombudsman from a person held in custody by an agency shall be forwarded immediately, unopened, to the ombudsman. [L 1967, c 306, §19; HRS §96-18]
